name: Shop Coupons
author: Alex - opengamescommunity.com
description: Redeemable codes that credit shop points. Adds a public redeem page, an admin module to create and track codes, and its own table. Written as the reference example of a ZnoteX plugin.
update: Added a redemption log to the admin module: who redeemed which code and when.
Coupon create and delete now show in Admin Panel > Logs.
